subject.title: fix(agents-bind): generate peer format for feishu group bindings

question: Which Feishu bind grammar should OpenClaw support for conversation peer routing while preserving existing account-scoped bind semantics?
rationale: The PR fixes a real peer-routing gap, but the permanent syntax and owner boundary are compatibility-sensitive and must be chosen before automation can safely repair the branch.

options.title: Preserve account syntax and add explicit peer support
options.body: Keep existing <channel>:<account> semantics and add either explicit peer syntax or plugin-owned Feishu conversation recognition with docs and tests.

options.title: Adopt Feishu two-segment inference
options.body: Accept that feishu:<value> may become a peer, but require upgrade notes, an account escape, and proof that existing account setups remain expressible.

options.title: Select another candidate PR
options.body: Pause this PR and use a sibling candidate if it better matches the chosen bind contract after review.

recommendation.title: Preserve account syntax and add explicit peer support
recommendation.body: Keep existing <channel>:<account> semantics and add either explicit peer syntax or plugin-owned Feishu conversation recognition with docs and tests.

likelyOwner.reason: Current local history points to this person as the recent owner across the bind parser, docs, heartbeat filter, and Feishu surface touched by the decision.
